dct_description_sm: This is spatial data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population for the Regional Municipality of Durham, originally published by Statistics Canada.This spatial data is of the Census Agricultural Region (AR) geography, of which Durham Region is a part. The boundaries of the AR extend beyond Durham Region. The column "CARUID" can be used to link to other census tables that enumerate or aggregate to the AR level.
dct_title_s: 2021 Census - Durham Region Census Agricultural Regions Boundary
